title: Number of Installments for an Additional Business Security Deposit
content:
**Credit department schedule.** The number of installments of the additional amount due on a business Security Deposit follows its size, measured against the held cash, which is the cash received on the deposit less the cash refunded from it.

1. Where the additional amount due is at least the held cash and no payment reversal was posted on the secured Electric Service Agreement in the 12 months ending on the payment date, the number is the kind's most installments plus 2.
2. Where it is at least 0.5 (one half) of the held cash but less than the held cash, with no such reversal, the number is the kind's most installments plus 1.
3. Otherwise the number is the kind's most installments.

## Numbers by kind

| Security Deposit kind | Most installments | At least the held cash, no reversal | Half the held cash or more but less than it, no reversal | Otherwise |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Small Commercial Service Deposit | 2 | 4 | 3 | 2 |
| Medium Commercial Service Deposit | 1 | 3 | 2 | 1 |
| Large Power Service Deposit | 1 | 3 | 2 | 1 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical Medium Commercial Service Deposit, held cash USD 6000.00, no reversal)

| Additional amount due (USD) | Number of installments |
|---|---|
| 6000.00 | 3 |
| 5999.99 | 2 |
| 3000.00 | 2 |
| 2999.99 | 1 |

With a payment reversal posted on the secured agreement in the 12 months, every row above is 1.
